We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no SMILES given. We have tools to get NMR spectra for sample at hand (carbon, proton, HSQC). Probably we need to infer from NMR data. We need to retrieve spectra then count methyl signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra to get carbon shifts; methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm. Also proton NMR for methyl protons around 0.8-1.5 ppm. Could also use HSQC to correlate.

We need to call carbon_nmr_spectra (no args).
